_comment: HIPAA guardrails config for this app, merged over the plugin's default policy. Only the policy owner sets a vendor's status (baa / no_phi / no_baa) after checking the signed agreement; new vendors start 'unverified'. Keys ending in '+' append to the default list. Every change raises policy_version and adds a change_log entry; CI fails otherwise.

change_log.summary: Initial policy from the template, warn mode.

aws.notes: Which account accepted the AWS BAA, and which services this app uses
